note: Pages now work like a big wiki: tabs for relationships, abilities, possessions and history, member lists for organisations, a ladder of Sequences for every pathway (see Pathways & Sequences), an A–Z row in lists, and a portal at the end of each chapter page.
You can now report mistakes from any page: use Report an error. Reports are public, but you only see the ones sent from chapters you have already read, and reports marked as spoilers stay hidden.

A new look: the wiki is now a Victorian casebook. Chapters are picked from a titled list, press / to search from any page, every entry shows when it appears in the story, and on phones the chapter control sits at the bottom of the screen.
Diary pages: the dated entries of Roselle's diary and Klein's notebook, word for word, in a new Entries tab and on each chapter's page. The wiki now tells you what changed after each update.
Faster pages and self-hosted fonts: the wiki downloads about half as much on phones and answers searches and pages more quickly.
